summary.problem: Existing video generation methods require training, leading to high computational and data costs.
summary.method: A training-free approach using pretrained video diffusion models to control object layout and motion with coarse layouts.
summary.advance: Outperforms prior work in overlap, trajectory accuracy, and visual quality across multiple scene settings.

summary.problem: Existing work lacks a benchmark to evaluate visual grounding in retinal OCT for multimodal large language models.
summary.method: RetinaGroundBench is introduced, with AggIoU metric and RetGrounder, an MLLM fine-tuned for OCT-specific grounding and textual integration.
summary.advance: RetGrounder improves grounding F1 to 33.9%, a 43% relative improvement over the best general-purpose model.

summary.problem: Existing streaming methods assume static scenes, causing pose drift and ghosting in dynamic 4D reconstruction.
summary.method: Stream4D uses causal KV-cache attention to decouple motion and static regions without training, adaptingively aggregating temporal cues and fusing with depth priors.
summary.advance: Stream4D improves camera pose estimation and static reconstruction, produces reliable dynamic masks, and mitigates ghosting on dynamic-scene benchmarks.

summary.problem: Existing VLA-RL methods struggle with delayed and biased credit assignment and imbalanced subtask mastery in long-horizon robotic manipulation.
summary.method: AtomicRL proposes a post-training framework with SAPO and BATE to address credit assignment and exploration, and a Real2Sim2Real pipeline for transfer learning.
summary.advance: AtomicRL achieves 3.6% and 4.0% improvements over PPO on LIBERO-LONG, and 9.5% improvement on CALVIN ABC-D, with 21.3% real-world performance gains.

summary.problem: Progressive image compression faces limitations in efficiently handling sequential latent inference under partial observations.
summary.method: The paper proposes bound-conditioned latent inference (BLI) to reformulate progressive trit-plane coding as sequential latent inference under shrinking interval constraints.
summary.advance: BLI achieves state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance, reducing BD-rate by 17.78% over DPICT and 7.96% over CTC on Kodak.

summary.problem: Existing GVC methods lack effective denoising in pixel space and rely on latent space denoising with limited visual quality.
summary.method: ResGVC uses a residual coding framework to denoise in pixel space by transmitting residual signals and employs a diffusion transformer as an entropy model for compression.
summary.advance: ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in LPIPS and PSNR compared to previous state-of-the-art methods, with superior visual quality.

summary.problem: Reconstructing 3D room metric geometry from fMRI and camera trajectories remains challenging due to temporal mismatch and lack of visual frames.
summary.method: DRAFT fuses a compact layout representation from the early visual cortex with geometric free space derived from camera motion.
summary.advance: DRAFT achieves layout r of 0.480 on ten scenes, outperforming camera path (0.446) and seven fMRI decoders (max 0.429).

summary.problem: Dynamic scenes challenge humanoid loco-manipulation due to vanishing cues and viewpoint changes, limiting current policies to only the present.
summary.method: WholeBodyMem uses object-guided memory to retain pre-history of object events, selecting key frames through causal tracking and cross-attention with object tokens.
summary.advance: WholeBodyMem improves success rates from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and 36.7% to 88.3% on real robots, while also boosting standard tasks from 70.2% to 86.9%.

summary.problem: Existing methods attribute motion to entire instances rather than localized moving regions.
summary.method: MoRSe jointly interprets two frames to predict a moving-region mask without optical flow or separate mask generator.
summary.advance: MoRSe outperforms other methods in accuracy and produces fewer false positives, especially on sequences with no motion.

summary.problem: Existing WAMs rely on costly iterative denoising for future video representations, limiting inference efficiency.
summary.method: FRED uses self-distillation to train WAMs to improve future video representations from noise in a single denoising step, with temporal context from historical observations.
summary.advance: FRED achieves 50.0% task success on out-of-domain tasks vs. 19.4% for competing WAMs, and improves zero-shot generalization and skill transfer.

summary.problem: Existing FUDA methods struggle with noisy pseudo labels, inconsistent source knowledge, and require multiple communication rounds.
summary.method: SKD-ETR combines Smoothed Knowledge Distillation and Exponential moving average-based Teacher Refinement to achieve one-shot FUDA with bidirectional refinement.
summary.advance: SKD-ETR achieves competitive performance with communication- and computation-efficiency, and robustness under noisy supervision on OfficeHome, Office-Caltech, and DomainNet.

summary.problem: Existing model selection for retinal vessel segmentation relies on aggregate metrics, missing structural fidelity and cross-dataset robustness.
summary.method: The paper evaluates five segmentation pipelines on 244 images across six datasets, analyzing performance, stability, error types, and reproducibility.
summary.advance: FSG-Net achieved highest Macro-F1 (0.77), IoU (0.63), clDice (0.83), and Skeleton F1 (0.78), while SA-UNetv2 had highest sensitivity (0.85) and Thin-Vessel Sensitivity (0.63).

summary.problem: Existing methods lack kinodynamic modeling and safety distances, leading to unsafe and unstable UAV navigation.
summary.method: KinoUAV introduces a kinodynamic benchmark with a trajectory generation pipeline and DFD labels for safe motion decisions.
summary.advance: KinoUAV-Agent achieves the highest success rate with lower yaw and collision rates, demonstrating improved safety and stability.

summary.problem: World models are trained to predict pixels but fail to improve policies effectively.
summary.method: DRILL uses a bilevel framework to train world models to maximize policy returns through imagined rollouts.
summary.advance: DRILL-IMG improves mean success rate by 13.1 points over WMPO and 7.9 points over RLVR-World.

summary.problem: Existing RS vision models focus on network architecture optimization, but the shift to VLMs has led to a data-centric approach due to computational constraints.
summary.method: The paper provides a systematic survey of RS datasets for VLMs, offering a practical guide for data construction, fine-tuning, and evaluation.
summary.advance: It addresses the lack of systematic data-centric surveys, guiding researchers in building high-quality, diverse RS vision-language datasets for specialized applications.

summary.problem: Existing methods fail to diagnose and correct failures in long captions, leading to hallucinations and poor visual grounding.
summary.method: The paper proposes PAGER, a GRPO training objective that uses position-aware rewards to improve grounding and reduce hallucinations in long captions.
summary.advance: PAGER improves position-wise grounding and pairwise caption preference by 12.3% while maintaining competitive global caption quality on detailed-caption benchmarks.

summary.problem: Existing fusion methods struggle to determine if sentiment prediction comes from modality itself or cross-modal interactions.
summary.method: I$^2$-KAN uses a multi-pathway framework to separately maintain intra-modal and inter-modal information, with task-decoupled linear-gated denoising bottlenecks and structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Network fusion.
summary.advance: Experiments on three benchmarks show that low standalone predictive utility does not imply low interaction-conditioned utility, highlighting the interaction-dependent nature of multimodal utility.

summary.problem: Existing LoRA methods are tied to a single pretrained model, limiting their applicability across different backbones.
summary.method: The paper proposes LoRA superposition, where LoRAs trained on different backbones for the same task are summed and applied to all contributing backbones.
summary.advance: LoRA superposition achieves a mean accuracy gain of 30.21 percentage points over unadapted backbones, outperforming other methods by 29.93 percentage points.

summary.problem: Existing methods struggle with jointly forecasting trajectory and 3D pose in team sports due to complex social dynamics.
summary.method: The paper proposes a socio-temporal encoder that fuses trajectory and pose at the input level using shared factorized attention.
summary.advance: The approach improves pose accuracy by 14.2% on WorldPose and 11.8% on 3DPW, outperforming prior joint forecasting methods.

summary.problem: Existing self-supervised Vision Transformers have unreliable patch-level representations for dense prediction.
summary.method: CODI improves patch-level representations by mixing teacher class-token distribution into patch-token targets during masked patch training.
summary.advance: CODI improves dense and image-level performance on benchmarks with aligned pretraining settings.
